channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Amazon S3 adds additional policy details to access denied error messages
item.description: Amazon S3 now includes the specific AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) and AWS Organizations policy Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in HTTP 403 Access Denied error messages for same-account and same-organization requests. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Certificate Manager supports switching from e-mail to DNS validation
item.description: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) now enables you to change the domain validation method on your existing ACM issued public TLS certificates from e-mail to DNS, without reissuing the certificate or changing its existing Amazon Resource Name… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports Oracle Application Express (APEX) version 26.1
item.description: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now supports Oracle Application Express (APEX) version 26.1. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Redshift adds rg.large and rg.12xlarge instance sizes in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
item.description: Amazon Redshift now offers rg.large and rg.12xlarge instance sizes for RG instances in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) and AWS GovCloud (US-East) Regions. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Clean Rooms supports minimum aggregation thresholds in custom analysis rules
item.description: AWS Clean Rooms now supports minimum aggregation thresholds for the Custom analysis rule type . (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SES click tracking now supports custom URL paths for mobile app deep linking
item.description: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) now makes it easier to support mobile deep linking with the new ses:custom-path HTML attribute. (1 source: aws)
